name: std::chrono::tai_clock::from_utc
intro: Converts the utc_time t to a tai_time representing the same point in time.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A std::chrono::tai_time representing the same point in time as t, computed as if by constructing a value of the return type from t.time_since_epoch() and adding 378691210s (378691210 is the number of seconds between the epochs of the two clocks: 1958-01-01 00:00:00 TAI and 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

summary: Converts the utc_time t to a tai_time representing the same point in time.

recommendedExamples.output: The time of the Unix epoch was 1970-01-01T00:00+0000.
recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::formatter<std::chrono::tai_time>
